title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | US Stock Market Today | Live: Dow soars 500 pts amid rising Treasury yields, crude prices - The Economic Times
text: Dow Jones Today | Nasdaq | S&P 500 Live Updates: The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 406.68 points, or 0.79%, to 51,756.66, the S&P 500 gained 33.57 points, or 0.44%, to 7,737.70 and the Nasdaq Composite gained 135.41 points, or 0.50%, to 27,074.78.AI sentiment continued to boost chip and tech stocks, with Microsoft up 3%, Qualcomm and Dell 5%, and AMD and Marvell Technologies over 1% each.Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid warned that the rapidly expanding AI and data-centre ecosystem could become interconnected enough to pose systemic risks. He compared the concern with lessons from the 2008 financial crisis, highlighting the importance of understanding relationships beneath AI’s investment boom.
